payload.title: Farm person references point into two unrelated id spaces: treatment veterinarian attribution stores an unchecked farm_workers id, and the task assignee picker writes either farm_workers ids or auth user ids into assignedTo, so a task given to a farm worker appears in nobody's task list
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/fish-health/entities/treatment-application.entity.ts:134-137 (veterinarianWorkerId is a plain uuid into farm_workers with no relation)
apps/farm-service/src/fish-health/services/treatment-application.service.ts:66 (stored as given; the input checks only @IsUUID at dto/field-capture.inputs.ts:178-181)
web/modules/farm-module/src/hooks/useTenantUsers.ts:76-90 (the assignee list merges farm_workers ids into the auth tenant users)
web/modules/farm-module/src/pages/tasks/components/TaskFormModal.tsx:62-66 (the selected id is written to assignedTo)
apps/farm-service/src/task/entities/task.entity.ts:213-215 (assignedTo is a uuid with no marker of which id space it belongs to)
apps/farm-service/src/task/handlers/list-my-tasks.handler.ts:28 (My Tasks matches assignedTo against the caller's auth user id)
payload.rule_violated: D8 makes the farm workforce an HR employee plus a farm assignment, and the repo single-source-of-truth rule requires a person reference to name one identity space.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-37, release R12.
